name: copilot-agent-monitor
description: Live graph of Copilot agents and sub-agents: who spawned whom, which tasks went to new vs. reused agents, and what each one is doing.

copilotAgentMonitor.sources.copilotSessi.description: Monitor Copilot CLI / Copilot SDK harness sessions (~/.copilot/session-state). These support sub-agent reuse.

copilotAgentMonitor.sources.vscodeTransc.description: Monitor VS Code Local-harness chat transcripts (workspaceStorage/*/GitHub.copilot-chat/transcripts). Sub-agents there are always new.

copilotAgentMonitor.copilotSessionStateD.description: Override the Copilot session-state folder. Leave empty for ~/.copilot/session-state.

copilotAgentMonitor.showPreviews.description: Show short (truncated) previews of task descriptions and agent messages. Full prompts and file contents are never shown.

copilotAgentMonitor.statusBar.description: Show running/idle sub-agent counts in the status bar.

copilotAgentMonitor.checkForUpdates.description: Check GitHub once a day for a newer release and offer to install it. The check only downloads release information from api.github.com; no session data is sent.

scripts.preview: node esbuild.mjs && esbuild scripts/preview.ts --bundle --platform=node --outfile=dist/preview.js --log-level=warning && node dist/preview.js
scripts.package: npm run typecheck && npm test && node esbuild.mjs --production && vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository --no-rewrite-relative-links
